# Arun Teja Godavarthi (ZeoSpec)

> Arun Teja Godavarthi, widely recognized as ZeoSpec, is an Ecosystem Builder, Rotaractor, and Entrepreneur based in Bangalore, India. He orchestrates global Developer Ecosystems, high-impact Strategic Partnerships, and Developer & GTM Programs.

## Core Identity & Roles
- **Identity**: Ecosystem Builder, Rotaractor, Entrepreneur
- **Also Known As**: ZeoSpec, aruntejagod
- **Location**: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- **Core Domains**: Developer Ecosystems, Strategic Partnerships, Developer Relations, Engineering Program Management, Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy, Open Source Strategy, Tech Community Growth
